title: pavonia fruticosa
intro: Pavonia fruticosa, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a type of flowering plant in the mallow family. It is native to tropical and subtropical regions of Central and South America and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The Rock Rose plant is valued for its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which can help to reduce pain, fight infections, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Pavonia fruticosa, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health.
